description: Cursor Agent CLI as a bare stateless engine node — `r4t engine cursor run`, one headless turn per wake with no roster or dispatcher; STATUS.md/LESSONS.md hold working state; enable private K7E memory with `a8s vars <name> set MEMORY on`. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Tune it with --permissions on the invoke lines below; `r4t engine cursor check` proves the argv still parses. Turn timeout defaults to 900s; override per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set MODEL with bracket options such as [effort=high] to select reasoning effort. A separate EFFORT variable is unsupported and errors. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
